titulo.alumno: Intermediate · Hobbies and leisure activities: Listening comprehension

intro: T2 · Elementary · Understand the meaning and details of everyday written exchanges; understand notices, timetables and simple descriptive texts. Topic: Hobbies and leisure activities. Focus: Listening comprehension (optional).

palabras.consejo: Practise the word within a sentence and pay attention to the tone.

texto: Listening to hobbies and lifestyle: train your ear to recognise leisure verbs. When you hear «พวกเขาออกกำลังกายด้วยกันทุกวัน», identify the plural subject «พวกเขา» [phûak-kháo], the long verb «ออกกำลังกาย» [ʔɔ̀ɔk kam-lang-kaai] and the frequency adverb «ทุกวัน» [thúk wan, every day]. You also notice the open intonation on «ชอบ» [chɔ̂ɔp, falling tone].

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «กิจกรรมเดินป่าและท่องเที่ยวธรรมชาติช่วยให้ผู้คนได้ใกล้ชิดกับสิ่งแวดล้อม» express?

opciones.texto: Hiking and outdoor excursions reconnect you with nature.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «กิจกรรมเดินป่าและท่องเที่ยวธรรมชาติช่วยให้ผู้คนได้ใกล้ชิดกับสิ่งแวดล้อม» from the text.

opciones.texto: Cooking at home at weekends is a pleasant and healthy hobby.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Looking after plants and flowers in the garden creates a fresh, green setting.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: Listen to the sentence. How often and what activity do they do together?

piezas.audio: พวกเขาออกกำลังกายด้วยกันทุกวัน

opciones.texto: They exercise together every day (ออกกำลังกายด้วยกันทุกวัน)
opciones.explicacion: Correct: «ออกกำลังกาย» means to exercise and «ทุกวัน» means every day.

opciones.texto: They read novels in the library once a month
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: it does not mention novels or libraries.

opciones.texto: They rest at home only on Sundays

pregunta.texto: Read the sentence and choose its meaning.
